criterion_scores.reasoning: Arg parsing, cd/SID discovery, state-dir creation, and jq write all implement spec correctly. Boolean validation and correction_rounds range-check handled as specified. jq -nc output has exactly the three contract keys (dod_met, dod_waived, correction_rounds), no extras; values validated before --argjson so real booleans/ints reach JSON. Waiver-log append parses 'item: reason' and writes {ts, session_id, item, reason}. Minor: --dod-met without a value silently nulls rather than erroring, but spec permits via default.

All required parts present: arg parsing, cd/mkdir/SID, jq write, waiver-log append with timestamp and per-reason iteration. No TODO stubs. Edge cases mostly handled (missing args -> defaults, --dod-waived true without --reason -> exit 2, jq failure -> exit 1). Gap: waiver-log append lacks error handling; the >> could fail silently on lock/full disk. Critical path (build_meta write) is error-caught; secondary log should not fail silently.

File placement (.claude/hooks/), shebang, naming, and tool choices (jq, date, no MCP) align with conventions. Respects the frozen contract (exactly 3 keys, no widening). Exit codes reasonable; set -uo pipefail is defensive. Minor: exit 0 on cd failure is unusual but intentional (graceful no-op for subagent context, per comment); not a violation.

No over-engineering, no ceremony, no duplicated state (last-write-wins correct), no fabricated data, no orphan metrics, no hardcoded secrets. Waiver-log stores full reason strings (not lossy). Documents the Stop-hook contract transparently. No tombstoned decisions resurrected. Lean, focused.

Legible with explicit variable names; comments explaining the contract and session-id discovery are excellent. Errors logged to stderr. Gap: waiver-log append has no error handling; silent failure leaves no trace. exit 0 on cd failure is explained in comments. No validation that .claude/artifacts is writable before appending.

alex_ack: agree (2026-07-15, Alex) — scores match Alex's read; the waiver-log error-handling + exit-code-on-cd-fail docks are fair minor nits, not blockers.
top_fixes: Add error handling to the waiver-log append (2>/dev/null || warn to stderr) to surface silent failures without halting.
Optional: exit 1 (not 0) on cd failure so a failed run is discoverable.
